settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Adjust language, rendering, and quality options.

lock_tilt.label: Camera Tilt Lock
lock_tilt.description: Locks vertical camera rotation while horizontal rotation stays free.

settings.cost_legend: LOW / MED / HIGH indicators represent performance impact. If you experience lag or frame drops, try disabling HIGH items first.

lighting.section_caption: Real-time lighting effects for the Sun and Moon

shadow_map.label: Shadows
shadow_map.description: Renders real-time dynamic shadows based on the positions of the Sun and Moon.

rim_light.label: Rim Light
rim_light.description: Adds a subtle highlight along object silhouettes to separate them from the background.

god_rays.label: God Rays
god_rays.description: Realistic sun shafts streaming through gaps in terrain and objects.

post_fx.section_caption: Visual effects applied across the entire screen

ao.label: Ambient Occlusion (AO)
ao.description: Enhances depth by adding detailed contact shadows in crevices and corners.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.description: Adds a soft glow to the brightest things in the scene — the sun, the moon, and the night location beacon.

tilt_shift.label: Tilt-Shift
tilt_shift.description: Blurs the top and bottom of the screen to create a miniature diorama effect.

chromatic_aberration.label: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic_aberration.description: Fringes light slightly at the edges of the screen to simulate camera lens distortion.

character.section_caption: Choose who walks around with you on the map

smaa.label: SMAA
smaa.description: Smooths jagged object edges for a cleaner, crisper display.

supersample.label: High-Resolution Rendering
supersample.description: Renders the screen at up to 2x resolution for a sharper image.

texture_pack.label: Textures
texture_pack.description: Applies detailed pixel-art textures to block and object surfaces instead of flat colors.

quality.section_caption: Adjust screen clarity and detail settings

disclaimer.demo_notice: This service is a demo, and data may disappear or it may be discontinued without notice.
disclaimer.coverage_notice: Currently, only regions in South Korea are supported; all other areas are displayed as ocean.
disclaimer.storage_notice: Objects you place are not saved to the server, and are stored only on this device.
disclaimer.location_notice: Location names are queried using OSM Nominatim, and your location data is neither collected nor saved.
disclaimer.character_notice: Theme is an experimental feature. The CC0-licensed <kenney>Kenney</kenney> asset pack is applied.

about.tagline: Real-world terrain becomes a canvas for stacking virtual blocks.

orientation.unsupported: This environment doesn't support the orientation sensor.
orientation.permission_error: An error occurred while requesting orientation sensor permission.

geolocation.unsupported: This environment doesn't support location services.
